verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law firm, but any firm website could publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. The probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404) and no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. Nothing else in the pack points to agent-oriented documentation; the 'AI-based systems' boilerplate describes internal advisory tooling, not docs for user agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
